newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium sold 5.3 bln Bfr state notes.
newsitem.headline: Belgium sold 5.3 bln Bfr state notes.

text.p: The Belgian finance ministry said on Monday an issue of state notes had raised 5.289 billion Belgian francs by the end of the third day of subscriptions.
The ministry said that to date it had sold 3.734 billion francs of five year notes, extendable to seven years. The notes carry a fixed coupon of 4.70 percent.
Notes with revisable coupons and put options after three, five and seven years had raised 1.555 billion francs to date, the finance ministry said.
Subscriptions close on December 17. -- Brussels Newsroom +32 2 287 6817, Fax +32 2 230 7710
